deterministic_weighting_clarification.purpose: Resolve the original V16C preregistration's underdetermined portfolio-weight solution before any V16C.1 economics.
deterministic_weighting_clarification.optimization: Unique minimum-L2-distance projection of the 20 positive weight magnitudes from 0.05 each onto the three affine equalities: sum(long magnitudes)=0.50; sum(short magnitudes)=0.50; sum(sign_i * beta_i * magnitude_i)=0.0.
deterministic_weighting_clarification.solver: Closed-form Euclidean affine projection x = x0 - A^T (A A^T)^(-1) (A x0 - b); no iterative optimizer and no objective tuning.
deterministic_weighting_clarification.strict_sign_rule: Every solved magnitude must be strictly >0. Any non-positive or non-finite magnitude blocks ENTRY; no clipping, renormalization, asset deletion or replacement.
deterministic_weighting_clarification.numerical_validation: After solution, abs(net_notional)<=1e-10, abs(portfolio_beta)<=0.05, gross_exposure<=1.0+1e-10 and all 20 positions present; otherwise fail closed.
deterministic_weighting_clarification.singular_or_ill_conditioned_rule: If the affine system cannot be solved as an exact full-rank projection, ENTRY is BLOCKED; no fallback solver.
deterministic_weighting_clarification.beta_input: For each sealed selected asset, beta = covariance(asset daily returns, BTC daily returns) / variance(BTC daily returns) over the exact trailing 60 completed daily observations ending at SIGNAL close, using the frozen SIGNAL market price source; require all 60 paired finite returns and positive BTC variance.
deterministic_weighting_clarification.timing: Weights are computed only after the frozen SIGNAL ranking and causal OKX short admissibility set are sealed, and before ENTRY seal. No Friday/post-entry price or funding observation may affect weights.
